items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: We used to meet at recording sessions.

ctx.x: Yes. Dave was a great flutist and with a terrific sense of humor. It was a pleasure. We used to meet at recording sessions. And one of the sessions that I mentioned to you where I wrote some music for Giovanni Hidalgo. He was the kind of a guy, what they did is they put tape inside my earphones that I wasn’t aware of, and I put them on and I said, “You know I don’t hear things too clearly.” And everybody cracked up. That’s when I knew something had happened and I took off the earphones and there was this tape.…
I see David Byrne as someone listed that you’ve worked with.
